== Note on format ==

The volume ships raster figures rather than vector ones. A MediaWiki install
accepts PNG with no configuration change, while SVG needs the upload extension
list altered and the rasteriser bypassed. The masters are vector and the PNGs
are rendered from them at twice the display size.

Every figure carries an opaque background, so the set reads consistently on a
light skin and sits as a light panel on a dark one. That trade was chosen, not
defaulted.
